sites.what: Archaeological site in Argolida; the ticket covers the site, museum and Treasury of Atreus.

access.opening: Winter 08:30 to 15:30; summer up to 08:00 to 20:00. Closed 1 January.
access.tickets: Full €20 (about A$31.78 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), reduced €10 (reduced valid 1 Oct to 31 May only). Free first and third Sunday, November to March.
access.permits: No permit stated; entry by ticket.
